name: Osio Sotto (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of red and white, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Osio Sotto (a white griffin on red) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Osio Sotto, a comune in Lombardy; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Osio Sotto arms — white griffin on red, crowned, within branches
